name: B6 sheet management
description: Opens an isolated software fixture project (SETUP). In the design manager's Pages tab: Add sheet adds Sheet 2 (AddSheet); Rename edits it inline to Power (RenameSheet); Move up puts Power first (ReorderSheets); a resistor is placed on Power with real X input; Delete on the non-empty sheet asks first and lists its contents, Cancel keeps it, then Delete sheet and contents removes it in one Batch; Ctrl+Z restores the sheet and its part in one undo step. Refusals (blank or duplicate names, last sheet, malformed orders), the netlist across sheets and PCB net renames are covered by crates/eak-runtime/tests/sheets.rs; the controls' states by src/shell/sheets.test.tsx.
